port.ask: Serial port of the Titrino (the RS-232/USB box's COM2 on a Titrino plus, or the RS-232 port of a 7xx Titrino)
port.help: On an 870 KF Titrino plus only the box's second port (RS-232/2) accepts remote control; the first is for the balance.

dialect.ask: Protocol dialect: plus (870/8xx Titrino plus) or classic (758/784/787 and other 7xx Titrinos)

baud.ask: Baud rate as set on the instrument (plus: 19200 recommended; classic: 9600 default)

titer_mg_ml.ask: Titer of the KF reagent (mg water per mL), for the drift water-equivalent on the classic dialect
